notes.title: Degenheim Public Playtest - v 0.1.21 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings all!
Below you will find Fixes and Updates implemented in Degenheim Public Playtest version 0.1.21. 

[b]Levels:[/b]
- Further polishing to HUB tutorial markers
- Updated visual cues pointing to HUB NPCs
- Significantly revamped Tutorial and Onboarding sequence to avoid unwanted situations and make the game introduction more welcoming and rewarding for new players

[b]Items:[/b]
- Significantly improved item drops that should now reflect our idea of how we would like them in full release
Community feedback is extremely important here, let us know what you guys think and if the drops now feel more rewarding (but mind you grinding for highest rarities is still fundamental part of progression). 

[b]User Interface:[/b]
- Added new Reward Cards for revamped onboarding system
There are now 2 milestone cards, one right after completing Tutorial, and one after completing your second run.

[b]Game Balance:[/b]
- Notable increase to enemy HP past Chapter 2 to prevent “one-shots”

[b]Enemies:[/b]
- Significantly improved Crystal Beamer’s targeting marker to now be more visible amidst the battlefield and allow players to recognize threat and dodge in time

Truly yours,
Team Degenheim!

notes.title: Degenheim Public Playtest - v 0.1.18 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings all!
Below you will find Fixes and Updates implemented in Degenheim Public Playtest - version [b]0.1.18[/b]:

[b]Gameplay Content & New Chapter 4:[/b]
- Whole new chapter, featuring new challenges, enemies, minibosses, environments
- A unique boss fight, unlike any other encountered before
- Added breakable Destructible objects, dropping several types of power-ups, including highly requested Heals.
- Added a Vendor Room, where Straw Barry will be blessing Players with his help. 
- Added Buff Icons with Timers above the HUD, displaying all active abilities granted by Power-Ups and Items.
- Added Off Screen Enemy Indicators, to enable players to pinpoint the enemy position.
(Note: Should significantly help with locating Sultans and Laser Beamers to help with the Off-screen snipers.)

[b]Chapter 2 Boss Fight - Project Godjira / Shan:[/b]
We’ve felt the boss fight did not pose the challenge and variability it should have and one ability specifically stood out as not really fitting to the kit. Hence why we introduced multiple changes to polish the fight and make it more versatile and dynamic.
- Reworked the Project Godjira / Shan Boss fight by introducing different cooldowns to all abilities
- A complete rework of the Celestial Beam ability into 1 beam that actively chases the player after a short delay, dealing periodic damage
- Polished the animation for the horizontal Radioactive Beam so that the Boss does not go through obstacles anymore, causing unexpected behavior - beam being emitted through an obstacle that normally provides cover
- Visual adjustments to the environment - now features multiple Project Godjira logos, the city is in fires and includes more signs of havoc
- Several tweaks to Project Godjira / Shan Boss level to make the zone cleaner and more spacious 

[b]Items:[/b]
- Items are and will be undergoing a major quality overhaul, further balancing stats and more importantly updating the perks and abilities of all Items, to ensure an enjoyable experience. Item abilities have been shifted around and offer much more variety in terms of build creation. 
- Updated Tooltips on several Items.
- We also added a BUNCH of new items so that you have more stuff to play around with.
- All items now offer new benefits and effects when upgraded to higher rarities, totalling 72 new effects in total.

[b]Environments:[/b]
- Further fixes and polishing to existing maps, namely working on removing the invisible walls, adjusting the object colliders, and removing places where Players could get stuck.
- Fixed light and visuals in several maps. 

[b]User Interface:[/b]
- Added QoL change to Chapter Select UI where the selection automatically pans to the highest available chapter.
- Updated and corrected the Fast AF Boi Talent icon.
- Added QoL change to enable players to close Modal windows also by simply clicking anywhere outside of the currently open Modal window.
- Added NPC dialogues when first opening various menus in Player HUB.
- Added QoL change when starting a new game, players automatically continue with the last played character from their previous session.
- Added a heavily requested QoL change where dropped items at the end of the run now show Item Preview when hovering on the item icon.
- Disabled Player movement while Dialogue windows are open.
- Minor tweaks to how Character Unlock Progress is displayed.

[b]Talents:[/b]
- Implemented several new Talent options and increased the available Talent Cap. 
(Note: Talents will be reset and automatically redistributed to include newly added Talents after downloading the patch.)

[b]Abilities:[/b]
- Various Projectiles having the issue of colliding with VFX should now be resolved.
- Various VFX fixes where the player was able to get on top of the launched projectiles.
- Added an impactful screen-shake for Tomateor Ability.
- Added a QoL change to make it easier to differentiate between Bleed DoT color and the damage received by the Player.
- Fixed Zap VFX not always correctly displaying. 
- QoL updates to Ability Cards Tooltips. 
- Removed Ability Card selection after the Final Boss fight in any given chapter. 

[b]Sound Effects:[/b]
- Various minor SFX tweaks and fixes.
- Added several new Environmental and Destructible SFX. 
- Added Power-ups SFX.
- Fixed various issues that caused continuous SFX loops. 

[b]Game Balance:[/b]
- Further balancing and finetuning of the amount of dropped rewards in each Chapter.

Dash Johnson
According to player feedback and data, most players used to play Dash and neglect other characters. While Dash by himself was pretty balanced, he received a slight nerf to fit in better with others.
- Special Attack projectile lifetime decreased from 0.65s to 0.25s
- Base Crit Damage decreased from 200% to 140%
- Ultimate initial Attack Power conversion increased from 150% to 180%

Stacy
Stacy was perceived as too squishy and had several issues in the fluidity of her kit, exposing her too much at certain moments. Her kit was rebalanced and abilities made quicker, so that she may execute them faster and be less exposed to potential incoming damage. She still is a mid-range glass cannon, ripping everything apart while being less optimal build dependent, rewarding players who have mastered positioning.
- Base Attack Power increased from 60 to 80
- Base Crit Chance decreased from 25% to 12%
- Base Health increased from 240 to 310
- Base Armor increased from 50 to 60
- Primary Attack conversion from Attack Power decreased from 30% to 19%
- Primary Attack delay before shots reduced by 100%
- Primary Attack Speed increased by 30%
- Primary Attack Ultimate charge rate increased by 100%
- Special Attack conversion from Attack Power decreased from 140% to 100%
- Special Attack Ultimate charge rate increased by 30%
- Special Attack animation speed increased by 100%
- Ultimate Attack Power conversion increased from 80% to 90%
- Ultimate Attack now allows for movement while activating


Pyrokidd
Pyrokidd was rebalanced to be the squishiest of characters, as his kit offers the ability to play extremely safe, rewarding high skill players who are aware of incoming danger and good at dodging and positioning. His kit also received adjustments to its fluidity, making it much more enjoyable to play with shorter delays resulting in less skill demanded to hit enemies. He remains as one of the top damaging characters, as his Special Attack and Ult are extremely powerful.
- Base Attack Power increased from 110 to 120
- Base Crit Damage increased to 135%
- Base Health decreased from 330 to 280
- Primary Attack area increased by 20%
- Primary Attack delay decreases by 30%
- Primary Attack conversion from Attack Power increased from 15% to 20%
- Special Attack conversion from Attack Power increased from 50% to 90%
- Special Attack range increased by 12.5%
- Ultimate conversion of Attack Power increased from 15% to 20% per hit


Baba Med
Baba Med was always intended to be a slower, extreme damage powerhouse. However we felt he was a bit too slow, hence why we boosted his attack speed, projectile speed, and added the ability to move constantly while executing all abilities. His Primary Attacks are supposed to feed his wombo-combo, the special attack, hence why we made them deal less damage, but much easier to apply and maintain. We also reworked his ultimate ability into a huge straight line thunderstorm, demolishing all enemies within.
- Base Crit Chance increased from 5% to 6%
- Base Crit Damage increased to 130%
- Base Movement Speed increased by 10%
- Special Attack can now be detonated while moving
- Special Attack cooldown reduced from 5s to 3.5s
- Primary Attack conversion from Attack Power per Static stack increased from 65% to 85%
- Primary Attack Stacks (Static) duration increased from 6s to 10s
- Primary Attack Stacks (Static) maximum amount reduced from 5 to 3
- Primary Attack conversion from Attack Power decreased from 25% to 15%
- Primary Attack conversion from Attack Power for AoE damage decreased from 15% to 5%
- Ultimate completely reworked into a wide, long-range AoE

Technoviking
Technoviking was in a very good spot, together with Dash Johnson. He received minor tweaks so he would become what we have envisioned for him - a slow-ish, heavy hitting brute with far reach. We polished his kit to be more fluid and balanced a few stats to make him fit into the new balance better.
- Base Attack Power increased from 110 to 115
- Base Health decreased from 610 to 580
- Base Crit Damage increased to 130%
- Base Movement speed increased from 3.5%
- Special Attack animation speed increased by 30%

[b]Playable Characters:[/b]
- Fixed an issue causing erratic and unintended behavior for Baba Med in certain instances. 
- Updated Playable Characters’ Tooltips in the Bar. 
- Updated Stacy’s gun positioning. 

[b]Enemies:[/b]
- Updated the Hydra’s emerge invulnerability windows to allow Players to start fighting them immediately after the Enemy shows up.
- The Hydras should now correctly receive Poison DoT damage while submerged.
- Updated the Hydra’s submerge time, so they are more vulnerable after they attacked
- Updated the attack cooldown of all Ballerina Brutes, so they are more vulnerable after they attacked and they pose a lesser threat throughout all fights
- Further tweaks on Demonic Onesie charge attack to prevent collisions with environmental obstacles. 
- Fixed Jumping Normie Enemy invulnerability if killed mid-air. 
- Fixed AOE Enemies getting hyper-speed in certain instances. 
- Further tweaks on Enemy Attack Delay Timers to help prevent enemies attacking the Player immediately after spawning. 
- Further tweaks on several Mini Boss ground attack indicators. 
- Damage and HP balancing tweaks on some mobs, mainly Brutes, Beamers and Hydras.

[b]Misc and Other:[/b]
- Further fixes on issues caused when selecting Pause Menu option to Exit Run in various states of the game. 
- Updated visuals of the dropped Currency to accurately represent the D-Coin.


Team Degenheim

notes.title: Degenheim Public Playtest - v 0.1.17 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings all!

Below you will find plenty of Fixes and Updates implemented in Public Playest version 0.1.17;

[b]Items:[/b]
- Massively revamped the system how Items are being rewarded in individual Stages/Chapters. 
- Further fixes of Salvage functionality being available just once per game session.

[b]Levels:[/b]
- Added several new playable zones – Air Ship, Post-apocalyptic Mini Boss Arenas.
- Updated Final Boss arenas to match the theme of the boss fight.
- Added several tweaks and fixes to various level environments.

[b]User Interface:[/b]
- Minor tweaks to Chapter Select UI; locked buttons for unavailable chapters, removed obsolete chapters, updated selected chapters cropping and panning.
- Minor Pause Menu UI technical fixes.
- Added Player ID to the Main Menu of the game to help us resolve specific player issues.
- Fixed Sound settings slider bug where it continued adjusting the volume on its own.
- Removed Attack Speed from Stats available in Inventory.
- Fixed an issue where Stage Counter was shown on screen even outside of the run.

[b]Abilities:[/b]
- Introduced new ability card for Zap – Chain Lightning after reworking the system to correctly calculate DMG of subsequent jumps.
- Introduced new ability card for Zap – High Voltage.

[b]Sound Effects:[/b]
- Several new Sound Events prepared for environments.
- Added several new thematic tracks to the game to match the atmosphere of new environments.
- The beloved music tracks are now correctly back in the game. 

[b]Game Balance:[/b]
- Increased Damage AoE Zone shrink timer at Sugar Grandpa from 30 to 45 seconds.
- Updated existing Mini Boss arenas to provide better yet more challenging player experience.
- Updated various Mini Boss attack patterns in all chapters to provide more challenging player experience.
- Corrected Armor calculation system to calculate damage reduction values now more accurately.
- Further balanced Shan Boss difficulty.
- Revamped Talent data system and added new Talents to be now purchasable at Hank.
- Further tweaked several Abilities such as Burning Feet to now have Damage more in line with other effects.
- Updated all playable characters’ CRIT chance based on new Talent calculations.
- Updated all playable characters’ Armor values based on new Talent calculations.

[b]Enemies:[/b]
- Several Mini Bosses polishing.
- Fixed materials on Laser Beamer enemies.
- Fixed White Dasher enemy bug where they dashed off-screen and prevented players from completing the stage.
- Ranged Normie Vizier enemies now made easier to differentiate between single and triple projectile ones.

[b]Misc and Other:[/b]
- Mini Boss spawning points updated.
- Corrected Chapter 3 typo in Final Boss’ name.
- Removed some of the ground clutter and slightly updated coloring in Winter Christmas maps to help improve the visibility of enemies.
- Fixed issue where after selecting Exit Run option some enemies may have spawned temporarily in Player Hub. 

Thank you for sticking with us and stay tuned for more, HYPE!

Team Degenheim

notes.title: Degenheim Public Playtest - v 0.1.16 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings all!
After gathering all the feedback and reports from the first group of eager players (you rock!), and returning back from Christmas Holidays, we are happy to bring you several crucial updates to the game.  
Fixes implemented in Public Playest version 0.1.16;

[b]Items:[/b]
- Bug when Items disappeared from inventory window after equipping/unequipping them should now be resolved. 
(We will continue monitoring the situation to ensure all instances of this problem have been fixed.
- Bug which prevented more than 1 Salvage rounds per game session now fixed. 

[b]Levels:[/b]
- Implemented new final Chapter boss arenas.
- Added enhanced environmental mechanics to Sugar Grandpa boss arena.

[b]User Interface:[/b]
- Ability texts reworked to be easier to read.
- Currency should now properly update after upgrading an item.
- Added QoL change to enable players Exit Run from Pause Menu and return to Player HUB.
- Added QoL change to display stage/chapter counter during the run.

[b]Abilities:[/b]
- Dashing immediately after using Dash’s Ultimate no longer cancels the ability’s animation.
- It should be no longer possible to avoid internal CD on Dash’s Secondary Attack.
- Pyrokidd’s Primary Attack now correctly delivers animation and damage on designated position.
- Corpse Shot’s VFX now significantly distinguishable from Enemy projectiles. 
- Playing with Matches VFX on Bosses made less obtrusive.

[b]Sound Effects:[/b]
- Added several more sound events and effects.
- In various areas of Player HUB.
- In various environments.
- New character and NPC sounds added.

[b]Game Balance:[/b]
- All Ability descriptions undergone significant improvements and updates. 
- Several Tooltip issues resolved with: Auras, Incinerate, Agonizing Brew. 
- Poison and Fire Tomateors now correctly display impact damaging AOE.
- Auras’ VFX now corresponds to their actual damaging radius.

[b]Enemies:[/b]
- Bosses and Mini Bosses are now correctly immune to CC effects.
- Chapter 3 Mini Boss now correctly using forward leap ability on correct CD. 
- Beamer enemy should now always spawn targeting laser before firing the laser beam attack.
- Beamer enemy targeting SFX should no longer remain stuck in the replay loop.
- Chapter 3 Stage 15 should now correctly spawn all enemies allowing further progress. 
- All enemies given permanent red outline to improve visibility.
- Chapter 1 Mini Boss now tuned to correct difficulty.

[b]Misc and Other:[/b]
- Game Settings should no longer reset to defaults after restarting the game.
- Rebinding Interact button from default “E” should no longer cause issues ingame. 
- It should be no longer possible to open multiple Chapter Select instances.
- Various instances of missing walls where they should have been or invisible walls where they shouldn't have been now fixed.
- Resolved the issue where players were left with black screen after first death.
- Increased available purchasable Talents limit.
- Updated the Main loading screen.

Thank you for being such a great community, your continuous feedback is essential for the development of the game and is a key pillar to making Degenheim an absolute blast. 
In next patch, you can expect a bunch of new, juicy content additions!
Team Degenheim

notes.title: Degenheim Public Playtest - v 0.1.15 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings all!

First major patch notes readying Degenheim for influx of our new eager players are here! 

Fixes implemented in Public Playest version 0.1.15:

[b]Items:[/b]
- Grey items incorrectly updating past maximum allowed level 10 now fixed.
- Rapid item upgrade clicks duping items now fixed.
- Updated token rewards.
- Fixed Forge bug not showing higher level and rarity items.

[b]User Interface:[/b]
- Currency incorrectly displaying during run now fixed.
- Significantly improved Character Selection display and stat hovers and improved tooltips.
- Icreased visibility of the currencies in HUB.

[b]Talents:[/b]
- Rapid talent upgrade clicks now fixed.

[b]Abilities:[/b]
- Rapid ability upgrade clicks after stage end now fixed.
- Error while picking 2 passive abilities during 1st run now fixed.
- Ability debuffs not disappearing after entering the HUB now fixed.

[b]Onboarding Sequence:[/b]
- Stacy unlock after onbaording sequence completion now significantly improved QoL.
- Missing colliders in onboarding sequence correctly placed.
- Ability to get past the onboarding sequence stoppers now fixed.

[b]Sound Effects:[/b]
- Added several more sound events.

[b]Game Balance:[/b]
- Significant reqork to the enemy wave and stage setup.
- Bosses and minibosses finetuning.
- Ability cards rebalanced.
- Initial progression overhaul.

[b]Enemies:[/b]
- Updated damage idicators on Normie enemies.
- Updated damage indicators on Jack MK1 miniboss.
- Sugar Grandpa boss slash width fix. 

[b]Misc and Other:[/b]
- Several smaller tuning, tweaking and QoL changes.

Thank you for kicking off this adventure with us! Your feedback and analytics we collect is what will make this game slap even harder in the upcoming weeks and months. 

Stay tuned for more, because there is a lot coming!
Happy Holidays
Team Degenheim
